metadata.purpose: starter exercise catalog for a fitness tracker
notes: score_weight is a product/design weight for points, not a medical or scientific effectiveness rating.
Use primary_muscles and secondary_muscles for filtering and muscle distribution analytics.
Use tracking_type to decide which fields to ask from the user: weight, reps, duration, distance, hold time, etc.
